caption:
The trip from Salvador to Morro de São Paulo is easier when you know what each stretch looks like.

A pick-up by air-conditioned van, a ferry across the bay, another van along the coast, and a fast boat for the last few minutes. We walk you through it step by step, from the pick-up to the pier, plus a few things worth knowing before you land.

Send us your arrival date and we'll help you choose how to get here.

#MorroDeSaoPaulo #IlhaDeTinhare #HowToArrive #Bahia

campos.label: How to arrive
campos.title: From Salvador to Morro, *step by step*
campos.subtitle: What each stretch of the semi-terrestrial transfer looks like
campos.alt: A Semi Terrestre wristband on a passenger's wrist, with the sea behind

campos.label: Pick-up
campos.title: It starts with a *pick-up*
campos.body: An air-conditioned van collects you at your hotel or the airport. Then you wait in a lounge with air conditioning, a bathroom, water and coffee.
campos.alt: A traveler with a backpack walking along a seaside path

campos.label: Salvador to Mar Grande
campos.title: Then a *ferry* across the bay
campos.body: From the Salvador terminal, a public ferry crosses the bay to Mar Grande in about 40 minutes.
campos.alt: The wake of a ferry crossing the bay of Salvador

campos.label: Mar Grande to Bom Jardim
campos.title: Then an air-conditioned *van*
campos.body: About 130 km along the coast, around 1 hour 40 minutes, with no stops on the way.

campos.label: Bom Jardim to Morro
campos.title: The last stretch is *by sea*
campos.body: A fast boat covers the final crossing to Morro de São Paulo in about 12 minutes.
campos.alt: Spray along the hull of a fast boat crossing to Morro de São Paulo

campos.label: Along the way
campos.title: A guide with you *all the way*
campos.body: From the first pick-up to the pier in Morro, someone from the local team stays with you, so you never have to figure it out alone.

campos.label: Good to know
campos.title: Plan *around* the transfer
campos.body: If you fly in, your flight should land at least 90 minutes before the transfer. When leaving Morro, be at the pier 30 minutes before departure.

campos.label: Other ways
campos.title: Prefer another *option*?
campos.body: Private transfers are also possible, and there is a catamaran too. The semi-terrestrial one is simply the most local way to arrive.

campos.title: Plan your arrival with people who *know the island*
campos.body: Send us your arrival date and we'll help you choose.
